metadata.content:
*Wisps of psychic energy ripple visibly from your brain as you force the target to move using only your mind.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |                                 **Maneuver** |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**    | **🎯 Self or one [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 1 creature or object** |

**Effect:** You [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) the target up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.

**Spend 2+ Clarity:** The size of the creature or object you can target increases by 1 for every 2 clarity spent.

**Spend 3 Clarity:** You can vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) the target.
